description: Creates a new incident action and associates it with the specified incident.

parameters.name: run_configurable_validations
parameters.description:
Whether or not Configurable validations from the Incident/Injury Configurable Field Set should be run (default: false).
See (https://developers.procore.com/reference/configurable-field-sets#list-pr...

id.description: Unique identifier for this incident action.

incident_id.description: Identifier of the parent incident this action belongs to. Use as the incident_id query parameter to scope action lists.

id.description: Unique identifier for this incident action type. Use as the {id} path parameter in GET/PATCH/DELETE requests to /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/incidents/action_types/{id}.

name.description: Display name of the action type, localized to the requester's language preference.

name_key.description: Untranslated key for the action type name. Use this value for programmatic comparisons rather than the localized name field.

active.description: Represents whether an Incident Action Type is available for use.

global.description: Represents whether an Incident Action Type has been provided by Procore.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this action type was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update to this action type.

url.description: Download URL for the full-size attachment file.

thumbnail_url.description: URL for a large thumbnail preview of the attachment.

name.description: Original filename of the uploaded attachment, including file extension.

content_type.description: MIME type of the attachment file (e.g. application/pdf, image/jpeg).

viewable_document_id.description: Identifier of the associated viewable document for in-browser rendering. Null if the attachment has not been converted for viewing.

viewable.description: Indicates whether the attachment can be viewed in-browser. True if the file type supports viewing or a viewable document has been generated.

can_be_viewed.description: Indicates whether the attachment has finished processing and is ready for in-browser viewing.

description.description: The account of the action in rich text form.

description_plain_text.description: Plain-text version of the action description, with all HTML markup stripped.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this action was created.

deleted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this action was soft-deleted (moved to Recycle Bin). Null if the action has not been deleted.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update to this action.

observation_id.description: Identifier of the linked observation item, if this action is associated with an observation. Null if no observation is linked.

data_type.description: The data type of the Custom Field Definition.

value.description: The value of the custom field.

incident_id.description: Identifier of the incident to associate this action with. Required on create.

action_type_id.description: Identifier of the action type to classify this action. Obtain valid IDs from GET /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/incidents/action_types.

description.description: Description of action taken, in HTML rich-text format.

drawing_revision_ids.description: Array of drawing revision IDs to attach to this action.

file_version_ids.description: Array of file version IDs to attach to this action.

form_ids.description: Array of form IDs to attach to this action.

image_ids.description: Array of image IDs to attach to this action.

upload_ids.description: Array of upload identifiers (from the Uploads endpoint) to attach to this action.
